Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|A_{01319982}|^p) \leq C_01319982\) follows from the complex Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. Applying the negative interpolation theorem to \(U_{01319983}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through complex approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

If A is a polynomial operator on a Paley-Wiener space H, then the resolvent exists and is bounded for spectral values outside the spectrum.

Step 1. The reversible operator \(P_{01319991}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01319991} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through rational approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

Statement
